newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto details output of new gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto details output of new gold mine.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co said on Wednesday it produced a total of 1,128 kg of gold bullion and 582 kg of silver solutions in the first five months of the year.

Lepanto president Artemio Disini told the Philippine Stock Exchange total value of gold and silver extracted from its Victoria gold mine in Benguet province in the northern Philippines reached 224.34 million pesos from January to May.
"We are on track with our Victoria gold project," Disini told Reuters.
Gold milling from the Victoria ore started on March 16.

Lepanto's switch to gold mining, however, led to a drop in its copper production to 2,358 dry metric tonnes of concentrates in the first five months of the year compared with 15,551 in the same period last year.
